parameters.query:
INSERT INTO coexistence.ia360_meeting_links 
(token, event_id, contact_number, kind, start_utc, end_utc, summary, zoom_join_url, zoom_meeting_id, created_at, expires_at)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9, NOW(), $10::timestamptz + INTERVAL '30 days')
ON CONFLICT (token) DO NOTHING
RETURNING token, event_id, kind, start_utc, end_utc, zoom_join_url, zoom_meeting_id;
